title: Matching
subtitle: Resource matching suggestions — AI-ranked connections between portfolio companies, people, and resources.

blocks.title: Matching engine warming up
blocks.body: The Matching Agent will generate connection suggestions once enough sourcing leads and resource data accumulate. Currently 14 portfolio companies (9 invested, 1 shelved, 4 Demo Day candidates) are indexed and available for matching across 14 sectors.

blocks.content:
The **Matching Agent** analyzes portfolio companies, sourcing leads, and the resource network to surface high-value introductions and partnership opportunities.

Matches are ranked by **confidence score** (0–100%) based on:
- **Sector alignment** — shared industry, technology stack, or market
- **Team complementarity** — founder backgrounds that create synergy
- **Timing** — funding stage, growth phase, and market readiness
- **Network proximity** — existing connections through SSG's resource graph
